subject: Sponsor flight connection — need to shift demo to align VP arrival
messages:
From: Alex Ng <alex@clearwave.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.s@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@clearwave.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: VP connecting flight — could we nudge the demo later on 6/22?

Hey Hannah,

Quick heads-up: our VP of Engineering (Ethan Park) just had his connecting flight rebooked and the new arrival into SFO is 6/22 at ~15:20 local. He really wants to join the walkthrough, but that means the current 15:00 demo slot won't work.

Two constraints from our side: the VP needs a short buffer after landing (~45m) to get to the office, and the exec sponsor prefers the meeting before 18:00 local. If possible, can Redwood shift the demo later on 6/22 (ideally 16:30 or 17:00) or move to 6/23 AM?

I attached his itinerary so you can see the connection. Sorry for the late change — airline rebook happened this morning.

Thanks,
Alex
-- 
Alex Ng
Senior Product Ops, ClearWave Health
[e: alex@clearwave.com]
[attachment: ClearWave_VP_itinerary.pdf (PDF, 284KB)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.s@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ng <alex@clearwave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VP connecting flight — could we nudge the demo later on 6/22?

Thanks for the note, Alex — appreciate the flag.

Short answer: yes, we can accommodate, but I want to confirm a few things so we don't leave your VP waiting or force an awkward split session. Two options from our side:

- Option A: Shift to 16:30 PT on 6/22. Our typical exec slot is 60 minutes; we can compress to 45 minutes focused on the sponsor-facing highlights and hand off deeper technical questions to Karthik and the eng team after.
- Option B: Keep 6/22 at 15:00 for your broader team and then schedule a 30-minute handoff at 17:30 for the VP only (quick exec summary + Q&A).

Before I lock either, can you confirm: is 16:30 or 17:00 doable for Ethan? If he absolutely needs that 45m buffer, 17:00 would be safer.

Looping in Karthik and Marissa — Karthik, can you confirm coverage if we compress to 45m or if you prefer to split into the 17:30 handoff? Marissa, would you prefer I update the calendar invite now or wait until Alex confirms?

- Hannah

Hannah Schmitt
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah.s@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0122
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.s@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VP connecting flight — could we nudge the demo later on 6/22?

Thanks Hannah. Either approach works from an engineering standpoint but want to flag trade-offs:

- If we compress the session to 45m at 16:30, we should prioritize: 1) high-level value and business outcomes (Hannah), 2) one short demo flow (Marissa), 3) open Q&A for 10–15m. That means skipping the deep KV-cache/quantization micro-ops discussion — fine for later.
- If we do a 15:00 general session and a 17:30 exec handoff, I can prepare a 10–12 slide one-pager focused on performance SLOs and fallback behavior for Ethan to review quickly. I can also remain on the 15:00 call and then join the 17:30 handoff if schedule allows.

Either choice is doable. My preference is Option B (split) — reduces risk if Ethan's arrival slips again and gives him a short dedicated window.

Karthik

Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: Alex Ng <alex@clearwave.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.s@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@clearwave.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VP connecting flight — could we nudge the demo later on 6/22?

Hi all — confirmed with Ethan. He asked for a single consolidated exec slot so he can join once and not do two handoffs. New constraint: he lands at SFO ~15:25, wants at least 45 minutes to clear customs and get to the office, and would prefer the meeting start no later than 17:00 PT.

So the sweet spot is 16:45–17:30 PT on 6/22. That keeps the session under an hour and fits his buffer. If Redwood can do 16:45 start with a ~45m agenda (exec highlights + one strong demo flow + 10–15m for Q&A), we'll take it.

Attaching the itinerary again and Jamie is copying our office manager for logistics. Apologies for the churn — appreciate the flexibility.

Alex
[attachment: ClearWave_VP_itinerary.pdf (PDF, 284KB)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.s@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ng <alex@clearwave.com>, Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@clearwave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VP connecting flight — confirmed 16:45 start and updated agenda

Great — we can do 16:45 PT and will run a tight 45-minute exec session. Updated plan below and I've attached a concise agenda (Demo_Agenda_v2.docx). I'll also update the calendar invite and send a new Google Meet link in a separate email.

Plan (6/22, 16:45–17:30 PT)
- 16:45–16:50: Quick intros & outcomes (Hannah)
- 16:50–17:10: Sponsor-facing demo flow (Marissa)
- 17:10–17:25: Ops & performance Q&A (Karthik)
- 17:25–17:30: Next steps & wrap (Hannah)

If Ethan's ETA changes again and he needs a 30m window only, we'll compress to the first two bullets and push technical follow-up to a short breakout.

Attachments: Demo_Agenda_v2.docx
Calendar: https://redwood.app/calendar/event/983274
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/clearwave/CW-2027-0421

See you all Thursday — Hannah
